title: Finite coproduct from clopen decomposition
statement: Intermediate theorem stated in the Lean module; see declaration for the complete type.

proof.text: Use Scheme.Hom.finite_preimage_singleton to put a Fintype structure on the set-theoretic fibre. The inverse of Fintype.equivFin enumerates its points, including an empty fibre.

Take the whole source as each unramified open neighbourhood. The open diagonal gives FormallyUnramified f; composition with the top-open inclusion preserves formal unramifiedness, and FormallyUnramified.isOpenImmersion_diagonal gives the required open diagonal of the restriction.

The input list is not assumed exhaustive, so the proof re-enumerates the entire fibre rather than using that list. Surjectivity of the equivalence proves the exhaustive-list hypothesis. The last clause of the decomposition theorem then says that the closed remainder has no point above the chosen base point.
The second projection p is finite by base change, so the image Z of the closed remainder is closed and avoids u. Set O equal to its open complement; u belongs to O. The composite O.ι ≫ g is etale.

Form the canonical map k from pullback f (O.ι ≫ g) to pullback f g. Pullback pasting cancellation proves that k and the new second projection form a pullback square over O.ι and p. Its commutativity shows that the inverse image of W is empty: otherwise a point of O would belong to Z. Take inverse images of all V along k. Inverse images preserve closedness, disjointness and suprema, so these opens are disjoint, closed, and cover the new pullback.

Each new piece inclusion is an open immersion with closed range, hence a closed immersion by IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion. Scheme.Hom.resLE and IsOpenImmersion.isPullback identify its map to the corresponding old piece. Paste this square with the square for k. The composite to O is a base change of the old closed immersion, hence is a closed immersion.

Reindex the finite sigma family by ULift into Type u. Apply Mathlib nonempty_isColimit_cofanMk_of to the disjoint covering open inclusions. This criterion gives the coproduct universal property: morphisms on the pieces glue uniquely because overlaps are empty. The chosen point of O maps to x, and the open and closed immersion properties were proved above.

lean.statement: theorem finite_coproduct_of_unramified_decomposition {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsOpenImmersion (pullback.diagonal f)] (x : X) (n : ℕ) (pts : Fin n → Y) (hpts : ∀ i, f.base (pts i) = x) (h : ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (g : U ⟶ X) (u : U), Etale g ∧ g.base u = x ∧ ∃ (m : Fin n → ℕ) (W : (pullback f g).Opens) (V : (Σ i : Fin n, Fin (m i)) → (pullback f g).Opens), IsClosed (W : Set ↥(pullback f g)) ∧ (∀ a, IsClosed (V a : Set ↥(pullback f g))) ∧ Pairwise (fun a b ↦ Disjoint (V a) (V b)) ∧ (∀ a, Disjoint W (V a)) ∧ W ⊔ iSup V = ⊤ ∧ (∀ a, IsClosedImmersion ((V a).ι ≫ pullback.snd f g) ∧ u ∈ Set.range (((V a).ι ≫ pullback.snd f g).base)) ∧ (∀ p : ↥(pullback f g), p ∈ W → (pullback.snd f g).base p = u → ∀ i, (pullback.fst f g).base p ≠ pts i) ) : ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (g : U ⟶ X) (u : U), Etale g ∧ g.base u = x ∧ ∃ (J : Type u) (V : J → Scheme.{u}) (ι : ∀ j, V j ⟶ pullback f g), Finite J ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (pullback f g) ι)) ∧ (∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (ι j) ∧ IsClosedImmersion (ι j)) ∧ (∀ j, IsClosedImmersion (ι j ≫ pullback.snd f g))
